questions.question: Case Study: 6-year-old Leo developed a paralyzing fear of thunder after a violent storm. Now, whenever he sees a bright camera flash, his heart races with fear. What classical conditioning mechanism explains his reaction to the camera flash?
questions.explanation: Generalization occurs when stimuli resembling the conditioned stimulus (lightning/flash) evoke the conditioned emotional response.

questions.question: Case Study: In the storm scenario above, what was the original Unconditioned Stimulus (US) that triggered the innate startle response?
questions.explanation: The loud noise of the thunderclap naturally and automatically triggered an unconditioned startle response.

questions.question: Case Study: A graphic design firm creates a brand logo featuring an incomplete silhouette of a lion. Customers effortlessly perceive a complete, majestic lion. Which Gestalt grouping principle explains this?
questions.explanation: Closure causes the human perceptual system to automatically fill in visual gaps to perceive a unified form.

questions.question: Case Study: A sleep lab patient exhibits irregular breathing, high brain metabolic activity on EEG resembling wakefulness, but their limbs are completely paralyzed. What sleep stage are they in?
questions.explanation: REM sleep features paradoxical physiological activity: alert brainwaves with profound skeletal muscle atonia.

questions.question: Case Study: A mobile game gives players a mystery prize box after an unpredictable number of completed levels (sometimes after 3 levels, sometimes after 9, averaging 5). What reinforcement schedule is this?
questions.explanation: Reinforcing behavior after an unpredictable number of responses is a Variable-Ratio schedule.

questions.question: Case Study: A patient is prescribed a dopamine antagonist to treat hallucinations. As a side effect, the patient begins experiencing muscle tremors and stiffness. Which neurological structure is being impacted?

options.text: The Basal Ganglia and Substantia Nigra motor pathways

questions.explanation: Blocking dopamine in motor basal ganglia circuits mimics Parkinsonian extrapyramidal symptoms.

questions.question: Case Study: In an observational study, preschool children who watched an adult solve a puzzle by singing a specific rhythm imitated the song while solving the puzzle, while children who saw silent solving did not. This demonstrates:
questions.explanation: Bandura demonstrated that children reproduce novel behavioral routines through vicarious observational modeling.
